text_block_list.text:
It's my day off, so I decide to go watch
an
off-campus marathon for inspiration...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Dash!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: And the winner iiiis... Найс Нэйчер!
text_block_list.name: Marathon Director

text_block_list.text: ...Phew! I finished off strong!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Oh, uh, thanks... You came to watch,
huh?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: YЭпизод So I guess you felt like racing?

text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. Do you remember what
Palmer told
me before?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I wanted to try that whole "escape the
ordinary"
thing she suggested.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Look around... Not all these participants
are from
the academy. I figured that
racing against new
faces might feel kind
of refreshing...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Dang it! I lost!
text_block_list.name: Black-Haired Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
But that was so incredible, Nature! I
hope I can
beat you someday!
text_block_list.name: Black-Haired Umamusume

text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I know how you feel, but I'm not
so sure
we stand a chance!
text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Your specialty's short races, right? Why
don't you
just stick to those?
text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Umamusume

text_block_list.text: No way! I won't give up! I can't give up! I've got this feeling inside me that I can't ignore...
text_block_list.name: Black-Haired Umamusume

text_block_list.text: I will win someday! My heart, my body, and my soul are all crying out for victory!
text_block_list.name: Black-Haired Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Her heart... is crying out?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Everything was perfect! I had the win in
the bag!
But that darn Teio just had to...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Dang it, dang it, dang it! I can't believe this!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: ...Huh. I guess I felt the same way.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
It's because she hasn't given up that
she's frustrated and
eager to win.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I get it now... That's why when I lost to
Teio, I felt so...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Huh?! N-nothing! Anyway!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Siiigh... My face's burning up here... Guess I didn't realize I was this stubborn...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: ...Um, hey. Can I ask you something?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I don't suppose you know any tricks
people can
try to, you know, cool their
heads?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Out of the blue, she asks me for advice.
And what
comes to mind in the moment
is...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Going for a run might clear your mind.

text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you think I should get some sugar
to calm
down? Nice idea!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'm gonna go all in! Who cares
about a
little heartburn?!
Rub-a-dub-dub, bring on the
grub!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, ma'am, I'd like a chocolate
carrot.
Oh, and a fanfare soda, please!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Here ya are, Natie! Your sweet tooth's
really
acting up today, huh?
text_block_list.name: Candy Store Owner

text_block_list.text:
It's just been one of those days! So, any
other
recommendations?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Nature! Sweet stuff always hits the
spot after
a hard day of work, huh?
text_block_list.name: Black-Haired Umamusume

text_block_list.text: ...Whoa! You're those racers from before!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Oh my. Do y'all know Natie?
text_block_list.name: Candy Store Owner

text_block_list.text: Yes! We ran together in today's marathon! Nature was so amazing!
text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Hey, now... If you keep that up...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
My face is gonna burn up just as I was
starting to
cool down!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it. But that sounds a little like
a line out
of a sports movie or
something.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But sure! I'm in! That's exactly what I
need right
now!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Huff... That was harder than the marathon.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: I didn't think you'd be running till sunset.

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Well, me neither. Surprised
even myself
there.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But all that running sure set things
straight up
there in the old noggin.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's nothing. A little something just
occurred
to me is all.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I just figured... I'm actually pretty good
at
running, you know?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
With a clear head, it looks like she's
gained a
little confidence.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite all her fussing, Найс Нэйчер ends
up with
some sweet treats and even
sweeter friends.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
